The lowest bar in the chart corresponds to 'Румъния' (Romania), not 'Хърватия' (Croatia).
The value for the lowest bar (Romania) is approximately 0.77, not 0.2. The value 0.2 is far below any bar on the chart.
The chart does not contain a category for 'Хелзинки' (Helsinki). This is a hallucinated data point.
